# BluePilot: the upstream files bp-opendbc may change (#47). Every file that exists on master and
# differs from it in a PR's merge result must be listed here, with the reason; anything else fails
# the bluepilot-hooks check. Prefer moving code under opendbc/bluepilot_lateral/ to adding a line.

.github/workflows/auto_pr_review.yaml  # upstream's welcome comment, inert in forks
.github/workflows/release.yml          # upstream automation, inert in forks
.github/workflows/tests.yml            # also runs on pushes to bp-opendbc; its jobs fetch the library submodule
.github/workflows/update-cars-docs.yml # upstream automation, inert in forks
.github/workflows/update-uv-lock.yml   # upstream automation, inert in forks
opendbc/car/car_helpers.py             # bp-full: VIN in the "no fingerprint" log (#16)
opendbc/car/fingerprints.py            # bp-full: BluePilot 7's Edge MK2 name migrates to FORD_EDGE_MK2 (#35)
opendbc/car/ford/carcontroller.py      # one BluePilotLateral object, stock path as the fallback (#45); bp-full: BP longitudinal sends ACCDATA (sunnypilot/car/ford/bluepilot/longitudinal_ext.py), ICBM set-speed presses (sunnypilot/car/ford/bluepilot/icbm.py), BP7's cluster display replaces the UI block (sunnypilot/car/ford/bluepilot/hud_ext.py) (#16)
opendbc/car/ford/carstate.py           # bp-full: cruise buttons, posted limit, hybrid values (sunnypilot/car/ford/bluepilot/carstate_ext.py) (#16); Edge MK2 steering angle and gear (sunnypilot/car/ford/carstate_ext.py) (#35)
opendbc/car/ford/interface.py          # bp-full: the alpha toggle decides openpilot long vs stock ACC (sunnypilot/car/ford/bluepilot/interfaces_ext.py); every Ford ICBM-available (#16)
opendbc/car/ford/fingerprints.py       # bp-full: merge the BluePilot-only firmware from sunnypilot/car/ford/fingerprints_ext.py, Edge MK2 and Mondeo MK5 included (#16, #35, #39)
opendbc/car/ford/radar_interface.py    # bp-full: Steer_Assist_Data as a one-track radar on CAN FD (sunnypilot/car/ford/bluepilot/radar_ext.py), Delphi MRR holds radarUnavailableTemporary 33 frames after a scan-index freeze (#16)
opendbc/car/ford/values.py             # bp-full: VIN fallback hook, non-essential Lightning/Expedition EPS, Steer_Assist_Data radar on CAN FD (#16); Edge MK2 platform and ALT_STEER_ANGLE flag (#35); Mondeo MK5 platform (#39)
opendbc/car/structs.py                 # CarControlSP.lateralInputs, typed by bluepilot_lateral/host_types.py; CarParamsSP.lateralInputsRequired
opendbc/car/tests/routes.py            # bp-full: Edge MK2 and Mondeo MK5 untested until an owner route exists (#35, #39)
opendbc/car/torque_data/override.toml  # bp-full: Edge MK2 and Mondeo MK5 torque values, like the other Fords (#35, #39)
opendbc/safety/modes/ford.h            # one call per hook site into bluepilot_lateral/safety/ford.h (#46); bp-full: CAN Ford stock TX set on the BP stock-ACC bit, Set+/Set- only while controls are allowed (#16)
opendbc/sunnypilot/car/car_list.json   # bp-full: regenerated by platform_list.py with the Edge MK2 and Mondeo MK5 (#35, #39)
opendbc/sunnypilot/car/interfaces.py   # one call for the BluePilot safety-param bits (#45)
